Basis of preparation. Profit and margin figures use provisional assumptions pending finance sign-off: VAT 5% treated as a cost · funding rate 10% flat per deal · glycerin yield 11.1% of B100 · glycerin price $450/t (a $220/t figure is used elsewhere) · go threshold margin >5% and profit >$30/t. Correcting any of these changes every profit number in this report. See docs/deal-economics.md.
